the_signal.headline: n8n Agents ship: describe intent, pick model, deploy—no code
the_signal.body: n8n just launched Agents as a native primitive—you describe what you want, select an LLM, wire in tools and workflows, and it runs. This collapses the gap between prompt engineering and production automation. For GTM teams building AI-powered qualification or lead routing, this means faster iteration cycles and less ops overhead managing agent state.

tool_drop.name: n8n Agents
tool_drop.what: Native agent framework where you define intent, choose a model, attach tools/workflows, and deploy—no glue code required.
tool_drop.why: GTM teams can now spin up multi-step lead qualification or prospect research agents without building orchestration from scratch; reduces time-to-revenue on AI workflows.

thread_of_day.title: n8n Morning AI News Brief Workflow: $0.00004 per article scoring at scale
thread_of_day.takeaway: Fully instrumented example of cost-efficient content scoring and Slack delivery—shows how to batch LLM calls and score materiality without breaking budget.

quote.text: Every weekday at 8am, this workflow searches the day's AI news, scores every article for materiality at about $0.00004 apiece, and posts one cited brief per topic to Slack.
quote.source: n8n Blog – Morning AI News Brief

whats_moving.context: n8n's native Agents release signals that the industry is moving away from bolted-on agentic logic toward integrated, model-agnostic frameworks.
Multiple posts today (knowledge graphs vs. vector RAG) indicate GTM teams now need a deliberate grounding strategy, not just 'throw RAG at it.'

whats_moving.topic: Cost-efficient LLM inference at production scale
whats_moving.context: The $0.00004 per-article scoring example shows that batch processing and smart prompt design can keep multi-step AI workflows under budget.

act_on_this: Audit your current lead qualification workflow—if it's still rules-based or hybrid human/AI, sketch how you'd replace it with an n8n Agent, define the intent, and test on 100 warm leads this week.
